caption: A fresh launcher with favorites but no grid in the config: the only default is the favorites widget as a dock in the bottom row.
The grid from launcher.json: two AOSP clock widgets at their configured cells and spans, the dock full width in the bottom row.
Long-press on free cells enters edit mode: the cells wiggle, the edit bar offers Add and Done.
A tapped cell is selected: resize handle, remove badge and the +/- per axis, clamped to what the widget declares.
A drag with the finger still down: the digital clock has been carried onto the analog clock's cells and the engine already previews the push-down, the analog clock moved one row down before the drop.
Dropped onto the analog clock: the occupant was pushed down, nothing overlaps.
Remove shows a snackbar with Undo; the AppWidget host id is released only after it expires.
Tapping the dock in edit mode opens the favorites editor: reorder, remove, add; it writes the one pin list search uses too.
Done leaves edit mode and writes home.grid back into launcher.json on the device; the file is pulled next to this picture.
The same favorites widget one column wide at the left edge: a side dock, the shape that stays visible on both displays of a fold.
Favorites as a 2x2 block next to a widget: the list lays out as w times h icons, the rest stays reachable in search.
The config asked for a one-column digital clock, below its declared minimum: the launcher draws two columns and reports widget-too-small (diagnostics saved next to this picture).
locked: true in the config: a long press shows no edit bar and nothing is ever written back.
